name: Probiotics
longDescription: A little space for your daily care. Our Probiotics bring Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium cultures together in a compact silver tin. Take a closer look at the formula, get to know the label, and find a place for it in your routine.

gallery.label: A closer look

gallery.label: The details

details.title: Inside the formula
details.body: Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium cultures. The complete ingredient list, individual strains and amounts will be published with the final product label.

details.title: How to use
details.body: Follow the directions on your product’s label. Serving size and frequency will be listed on the final label before the store opens.

details.title: Storage & care
details.body: Check the storage instructions and use-by date on your tin. Keep the original packaging so these details are always close at hand.

details.title: Is it right for me?
details.body: Check the full ingredient and allergen information before choosing a supplement. Product-specific suitability information will be available with the final label.

faqs.question: What comes in the tin?
faqs.answer: 30 tablets in the silver YukoHealth tin. The tablet count is the pack size; it does not specify the number of servings.

faqs.question: Where can I find the full ingredient list?
faqs.answer: We’ll publish the complete formulation, strains and amounts with the final product label. The current product description introduces the two culture groups.

faqs.question: Can I order it now?
faqs.answer: You can explore the range and save products to your cart. Online checkout is coming soon, and your selections stay on this device.

name: Hand Lotion
longDescription: A small moment of care for hands that do a lot. Our Hand Lotion pairs bergamot and vanilla in a silver tube that fits beside the sink or into your everyday bag. Keep it close for the pauses between one thing and the next.

gallery.alt: Hand Lotion in an unbranded silver 50 ml tube
gallery.label: The tube

details.title: Inside the formula
details.body: Bergamot and vanilla are the scent notes. The complete ingredient list will be available with the final product label.

details.title: How to use
details.body: Use as directed on the tube. Keep it close to the moments when you make time for hand care.

details.title: Storage & care
details.body: Replace the cap after use and follow the storage instructions on the label.

details.title: Is it right for me?
details.body: Check the complete ingredient list for any ingredients you avoid. Skin-type and allergen information will be provided with the final formulation.

faqs.question: What does it smell like?
faqs.answer: The scent pairs bergamot and vanilla.

faqs.question: How large is the tube?
faqs.answer: Each tube contains 50 ml of Hand Lotion.

name: Hair Growth
description: A daily hair supplement for men.
longDescription: A hair supplement for men, in a simple silver jar. Designed to sit alongside your everyday care, with 60 capsules in each pack. Explore the product details here while we prepare the next update on availability.

gallery.alt: Hair Growth in an unbranded silver jar of 60 capsules
gallery.label: The jar

details.title: Inside the formula
details.body: The complete ingredient list and amounts will be available with the final product label.

details.title: How to use
details.body: Follow the directions on the product label. Capsule count describes pack size, rather than daily serving size.

details.title: Storage & care
details.body: Keep the original jar and follow the storage instructions and use-by date on its label.

details.title: Is it right for me?
details.body: This product is presented as a hair supplement for men. Check the full ingredients, allergens and suitability information when the final label is available.

faqs.question: When will it be back?
faqs.answer: Hair Growth is currently sold out. A restock date hasn’t been announced yet; check back here for updates.
